title: Global CMT magnitudes kept the order of all 45 matched deep ComCat pairs in 2000-2020
abstract: We replaced ComCat preferred magnitudes with matched Global CMT moment magnitudes in fixed deep earthquake pairs in 2000-2020. All 45 matched pairs kept their order, and 36 had the larger event first. The conditional group bootstrap interval for that share was 66.7-90.5%. Six replacement gaps fell below 0.3. Only 45 of 98 eligible pairs could be matched. All retained endpoints already had moment-based ComCat magnitudes, and some source estimates were shared. Matching lost 48 of 67 first-day pairs but only five of 31 later pairs. Thus this check shows stable order in a selected subset; it does not resolve the mixed-scale concern in the full sample. No direct triggering or external Earth-system cause is established. The package contains code, aggregate evidence, source hashes, a figure and an independent arithmetic audit. External catalog records remain outside the publication.
